module_role: Exact project/title-block/sheet context and complete full-page visual-review ledger for the supplied twelve-sheet Houston VA Emergency Room Expansion set.
scope: Complete ground truth for the twelve supplied mechanical sheets only. It does not claim that unprovided disciplines, revisions, submittals, controller drawings or record documents are part of the source.

revision_date.note: Blank revision-log heading/rows are not reclassified as revision events.

scale_semantics.finding: All twelve supplied pages were visually reviewed. The repeated title block does not print a document-wide scale field. Plan/detail captions and graphical scales must be read view by view; no universal measurable conversion is inferred from the title block.
scale_semantics.global_measured_takeoff_warning: The exact schedule/points cells are source-grounded. Any geometric takeoff should read the local drawing-view scale rather than applying an invented global factor.
